facts.fact: Madison 开场私评 Bonnie「太猛」，Frank 质问她是不是想把这次机会搞砸
facts.anchor: “Jesus. She’s intense.” Madison blew out a breath

facts.fact: Madison 揭底：原计划是潜入企业傀儡的巢穴、骗得合作再当面嘲笑，Roberto 澄清「那不是我们来这里的目的」
facts.anchor: We managed to infiltrate the lair of a corporate puppet

facts.fact: Madison 大骂 Bailey 为一枚 Tic Tac 就能出卖他们、Bonnie 是插着大棒的 Little Miss Perfect，宣称这一切不属于他们乐队
facts.anchor: And Little Miss Perfect? Anyone that makes people call her Miss Bloom

facts.fact: Roberto 以 headline、全球巡演画饼，Madison 心跳加速，暗骂他专挑她的自尊下手
facts.anchor: But don’t you want to be the headline?

facts.fact: 乐队六年史：从 Frank 妈妈的车库到本地酒馆再到 Leeds Festival，仍缺关键突破
facts.anchor: The band had been six long years in the making

facts.fact: Roberto 论人脉：合作能带流量与投资人，打入 Bonnie 的酷儿社群是金矿，成功即一夜改命
facts.anchor: Tapping into her queer community would be striking a gold mine

facts.fact: Madison 被「Madison Moore 不爱冒险？」反将后松口入伙，合同 NDA 签到手酸，又当着 Bonnie 面与 Scarlett 调情取乐，自认 This was gonna be so much fun
